non_claims: Nearest-rank empirical quantiles describe only the finite 100-member published ensemble.
The per-bin ensemble maximum is not a theorem that all possible terrain realizations lie below it.
Spatial support remains sample-points-only until LL-009R closes unresolved/subpixel terrain.
scientific_basis: Barker et al. construct clone realizations by adding realization-specific Z-error fields back to the nominal LDEM.
The observer height is therefore reconstructed from the same clone realization at the LL-009P site pixel rather than holding the observer fixed while perturbing surrounding terrain.
Every clone horizon scans every admitted source raster cell; LL-009L top-K candidates are not reused for ensemble statistics.
